rows.text: calls the site `00616210` + 0x9 with `rcx` (and `rdx`, `r8`, `r9` passed through unchanged), then stores the fifth to ninth (stack) arguments as dwords to `rcx+0x20`, `+0x24`, `+0x28`, `+0x2C` and `+0x30` and returns `rcx`

notes: 00616210: stack-argument numbering assumes the standard x64 frame (push rbx + sub 0x20, so [rsp+0x50] is the fifth argument). Whether the callee at + 0x9 uses rdx/r8/r9 is not visible here; the sentence only says they are left in place.
